sources.citation: Matthew Botvinick, Jonathan Cohen (1998). Rubber hands ‘feel’ touch that eyes see. Nature.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1998) in Nature establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: Manos Tsakiris, Patrick Haggard (2005). The Rubber Hand Illusion Revisited: Visuotactile Integration and Self-Attribution. Journal of Experimental Psychology: Human Perception and Performance.
sources.notes: Tsakiris & Haggard (2005 JEP:HPP) systematic experiments proving body-scheme anatomical congruence and synchronous timing gate rubber-hand ownership.

sources.citation: Marieke Rohde, Massimiliano Di Luca, Marc O. Ernst (2011). The Rubber Hand Illusion: Feeling of Ownership and Proprioceptive Drift Do Not Go Hand in Hand. PLoS ONE.
sources.notes: Rohde, Di Luca & Ernst (2011 PLOS ONE) psychophysical dissociation showing proprioceptive drift can occur independently of subjective rubber-hand ownership.

sources.citation: Laura Germine, Taylor Leigh Benson, Francesca Cohen, Christine I’Lee Hooker (2013). Psychosis-proneness and the rubber hand illusion of body ownership. Psychiatry Research.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2013) in Psychiatry Research extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Lénie J. Torregrossa, Sohee Park (2022). Body ownership across schizotypy dimensions: A rubber hand illusion experiment. Psychiatry Research Communications.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2022) in Psychiatry Research Communications extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Peter Lush (2020). Demand Characteristics Confound the Rubber Hand Illusion. Collabra: Psychology.
sources.notes: Critique demonstrating substantial trait phenomenological control / suggestibility variance across standard rubber hand illusion questionnaires.

sources.citation: H. Henrik Ehrsson, Charles Spence, Richard E. Passingham (2004). That's My Hand! Activity in Premotor Cortex Reflects Feeling of Ownership of a Limb. Science.
sources.notes: Human fMRI study linking ventral premotor and intraparietal multisensory integration directly to subjective rubber-hand ownership onset.

sources.citation: Daniel Pérez Marcos. "The rubber hand illusion."
